import itertools
def invnum(seq):
    N=len(seq)
    res=0
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i+1,N):
            if seq[i]>seq[j]:
                res+=1
    return res
def naive(N,k,flag):
    res=0
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(N),N):
        for q in itertools.permutations(range(N),N):
            if ((p<q) or (not(flag))) and (invnum(p)-invnum(q)>k):
                res+=1
    return res
